title: incident-bot: on-call runbook helpers + slo-toolkit autodiagnostics integration
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: on-call responders often need quick links from incidents to curated runbook sections and a concise diagnostic summary. This PR adds runbook helper utilities to incident-bot and integrates the slo-toolkit autodiagnostics runner so on-call messages include a compact diagnostics block and direct runbook anchors.

What this PR does: - Adds a runbook linker that maps SLO/alert contexts to canonical runbook anchors and short descriptions. - Introduces an OnCallHelper module used by incident-bot handlers to attach runbook links and a 3-line automated diagnostic summary from slo-toolkit. - Integrates autodiagnostics runner hooks so diagnostics are run asynchronously and results are appended to the on-call message. - Adds feature flag incident_bot.runbook_helpers with rollout default off for safety. - Includes unit and integration tests, updates docs with examples and a short runbook authoring guide.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation of runbook linker and helper module - [x] Hook integration with slo-toolkit autodiagnostics runner - [x] Unit tests for linker edge cases (missing anchors, multiple matches) - [x] Integration test exercising async diagnostics append - [x] Docs: docs/oncall/README.md updated with usage and rollout notes - [x] Feature flagged behind incident_bot.runbook_helpers - [x] Verified CI passes locally and in CI after last fix

Notes and rollout: Start with feature flag off. Enable for SRE alpha group and monitor incident-bot latency and ci/integration flakiness. Related Linear tasks: ENG-11234 (runbook UX), SRE-4478 (oncall automation). Related support ticket: SUP-2145.

release_notes: Adds on-call runbook helper utilities and slo-toolkit autodiagnostics integration. Feature is behind incident_bot.runbook_helpers flag. Improves on-call message quality by appending runbook links and a concise automated diagnostics summary.
summary: Feature: incident-bot now annotates on-call messages with runbook anchors and a short automated diagnostic summary via slo-toolkit. Safe rollout via feature flag. Includes tests and docs.
